# PinInput

```ts
import { PinInput } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

A masked, multi-digit PIN or one-time-code field. It composes the reusable Input Label, Radix's OTP field, the existing Icon Button eye action, and Helper String. Use it for a short authentication code; use Text Input for an ordinary password or free-form secret.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | — | Label text above the PIN slots (renders an InputLabel). |
| `showLabelInfo` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the label's 16px info icon. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Appends the label's "(required)" suffix and marks the field required. |
| `helperText` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Helper text below the PIN slots (renders a HelperString). |
| `status` | `PinStatus` | `'default'` | Validation state. error changes every cell border and the helper to the error tokens, and exposes aria-invalid. |
| `length` | `number` | `6` | Number of numeric PIN slots. The Figma component uses six; reduce only when the authentication service explicitly uses a different code length. |
| `value` | `string` | — | Controlled PIN value. Only numeric characters up to length are retained. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | — | Uncontrolled initial PIN value. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` | — | Fires whenever Radix changes the sanitized numeric PIN value. |
| `onComplete` | `(value: string) => void` | — | Fires once the PIN reaches length digits. |
| `visible` | `boolean` | `false` | Makes the PIN visible as digits instead of password dots. |
| `onVisibleChange` | `(visible: boolean) => void` | — | Called when the visibility eye button changes state. |
| `showVisibilityToggle` | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the existing 32px IconButton eye action. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Dims the slots, helper, and eye action, blocking every interaction. |
| `name` | `string` | — | Field name for form submission (Radix submits the combined PIN value). |
| `id` | `string` | — | Explicit id for the first slot (defaults to a generated id wired to the label). |
| `autoComplete` | `'one-time-code' \| 'off'` | `'one-time-code'` | Accessible name for a labelless field. Required when label is omitted. */ 'aria-label'?: string; /** Enables browser/SMS one-time-code autofill. |


## Usage

```tsx
<PinInput label="Verification code" />
<PinInput label="Verification code" helperText="Enter the six-digit code" />
<PinInput label="Verification code" defaultValue="123456" />
<PinInput label="Verification code" visible />
<PinInput label="Verification code" length={4} />
<PinInput label="Verification code" status="error" helperText="That code is incorrect" />
<PinInput label="Verification code" disabled />
```

## Accessibility

- Radix provides numeric validation, paste/autofill handling, roving focus, keyboard navigation, and a single native hidden form value.
- Provide label; a labelless field must receive aria-label. The helper is connected with aria-describedby, and error state sets aria-invalid.
- Each digit slot has an explicit accessible position name. The visibility action is an existing IconButton with a stateful accessible name.
- Focus is never removed: the current/entered slots receive the primary --stroke-150 border; disabled blocks all slots and the visibility action.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use autoComplete="one-time-code" for verification codes. | Split a code into unrelated text inputs. |
| Show a specific error in helperText with status="error". | Signal an incorrect PIN with color alone. |
| Use onComplete only after server-side validation is ready. | Treat client-side completion as authentication. |
| Keep the Figma-standard six slots unless the identity service requires another length. | Use this for a free-form password. |
